name: project-orchestrator
description: Portable project lifecycle orchestration for configured workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Run Task/Case work by the project contract: route tools and leaf Skills, verify, and deliver scoped Git changes
interface.longDescription: Reads the project's AGENTS.md contract, picks the smallest Task or Case, routes domain work to deterministic Tools and leaf Skills, then verifies, records progress and delivers scoped Git changes. Also ships a project menu that people can use without any AI agent (find files, see progress, project guide, checks, maintenance, records). Inventory, migration and sync of Agent extensions (Plugin/Skill/MCP) belong to agent-pack. 中文：读取项目 AGENTS.md 契约，选择最小 Task 或 Case，把领域工作路由给确定性 Tool 与叶子 Skill，再完成验证、进度记录与限定范围的 Git 交付；附不需要 AI Agent 的项目菜单。Agent 扩展（Plugin/Skill/MCP）的盘点、迁移与同步由 agent-pack 承担。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $project-orchestrator to discover this project's contract and run the current request through the smallest valid lifecycle.
